description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19,999. Grants [Zenith Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode: Red XIII] to user. Causes [MAG and RES -50% (25s)] on enemy. Grants [Attach Earth 3 with Stacking].

description.name: Zenith Mode: Red XIII
description.text: Increases Earth Infusion damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage, Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Red XIII after using a Earth ability (max 3), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Earth Rave+
description.text: Five single attacks (? each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses, causes [Imperil Earth 10% (5s)]

description.name: Spirit Attack: Red XIII
description.text: Grants [Buff Earth 10% (5s)] and [Quick Cast 1] to all allies

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action

description.name: Attach Earth 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3
